timelines.label: OUR VERSION — VEL-MER-OLDMONEY-GRID-01 (57s, Woman Over 40 VO)

beats.script: Every woman wants that old money look with her bag, but nobody tells you what actually makes it work.
beats.visual: GRID-B plate: four real street-style women with Birkins, centred serif title 'The Old Money Look / and what actually makes it work'. Creator keyed bottom-centre from frame one.

beats.script: That is until now, because this is the bag I carry every single day,
beats.visual: HARD CUT to our bag on the crook of her arm, coffee in hand. The grid is gone.

beats.script: and people ask me where it's from constantly.
beats.visual: Cognac carried past the flower stand, sidewalk.

beats.script: This is the Meridian from Velantra.
beats.visual: Brown three-quarter hero, clean hold on the name.

beats.script: It's grained leather
beats.visual: Macro of the pebble grain.

beats.script: with polished silver hardware,
beats.visual: Macro of the silver turn-lock.

beats.script: and it has the most perfect slouch.
beats.visual: Black, carried at her side, body relaxed into the slouch.

beats.script: It doesn't sit stiff and rigid like a work bag.
beats.visual: Cognac leaning on the floor by the console, relaxed.

beats.script: It doesn't look like it's trying too hard.
beats.visual: Black on the armchair, settled.

beats.script: It just settles. It drapes.
beats.visual: Black on the unmade bed, soft body.

beats.script: It looks like it's been yours forever.
beats.visual: Coffee brown set down on the bar, warm light.

beats.script: I don't want a bag that screams effort, and I know you don't either.
beats.visual: Coffee brown carried with a coffee, effortless.

beats.script: That's why I carry the Meridian.
beats.visual: Brown on-model PDP still.

beats.script: You throw your whole day in there,
beats.visual: Open top overhead on the bed, packed.

beats.script: laptop, planner, everything,
beats.visual: Laptop sliding into the main compartment.

beats.script: and the slouch just makes it look even better.
beats.visual: Brown carried at the crosswalk, full and soft.

beats.script: If you've been looking for that effortless, lived-in leather bag
beats.visual: Coffee brown on the entry console, lived-in.

beats.script: that actually gets more beautiful over time, this is going to be the one.
beats.visual: Picked up off the desk in evening light.

notes.title: SCRIPT EDITS
notes.text: 'full grained' -> 'grained' (grade unknown); 'hand-antiqued brass' -> 'polished silver' (hardware is silver in every photo); 'doesn't hold its shape' -> 'doesn't look like it's trying too hard' (PDP says holds its line). Slouch angle kept: on-model photos show the body relaxing. Laptop kept: photographed inside. Table in SCRIPT.md.

notes.title: INVENTORY FLAG
notes.text: 'They do sell out' is true (backorder strings on the page, ~1,760 oversold on 8/21) but the 8/21 block stands: no paid traffic until a restock date is on the page.

notes.title: PDP CAPTURE
notes.text: Scroll stops at Add to Cart + description top. The stale 'Drum-Dyed Full-Grain' and 'Florentine Brass' blocks lower on the page are never on screen next to a VO that says silver.

notes.title: CREATOR / PLATE
notes.text: C1 Eleanor and GRID-B chosen so this and the Vivienne ad do not read as the same woman and the same hook in one feed.
